name: untappd-mcp
description: Search Untappd beers, breweries, and venues; read profiles, check-ins, wishlists, and your friend feed; and post check-ins, toasts, and comments to your account

untappd_access_token.title: Untappd Access Token
untappd_access_token.description: Optional. An Untappd access token you already hold. Supply it and no password is needed (leave username/password blank); otherwise use username + password below.

untappd_username.title: Untappd Username
untappd_username.description: Your Untappd username (or the email you log in with). Required unless you supplied an access token; also the default account for user-scoped tools.

untappd_password.title: Untappd Password
untappd_password.description: Your Untappd account password. Required unless you supplied an access token. Used only to log in via the mobile xauth endpoint; never stored server-side.

untappd_client_id.title: Untappd Client ID
untappd_client_id.description: The Untappd mobile app client id. See the README for how to obtain it by intercepting the app's traffic. Needed to log in with username/password and for every write; a pre-seeded access token can read without it.

untappd_client_secret.title: Untappd Client Secret
untappd_client_secret.description: The Untappd mobile app client secret (obtained the same way as the client id). Needed to log in with username/password and for every write; a pre-seeded access token can read without it.

untappd_device_id.title: Untappd Device ID
untappd_device_id.description: Stable device UUID the token is keyed to (a default is provided).

untappd_user_agent.title: Untappd User-Agent
untappd_user_agent.description: Override the User-Agent (default mimics the app).

untappd_timezone.title: Check-in Timezone
untappd_timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York) that check-ins are stamped with when the call doesn't pass timezone. Set it when the server runs somewhere other than the drinker's zone (e.g. a hosted connector, usually UTC). Defaults to the server process's zone.

untappd_photo_dir.title: Photo Directory
untappd_photo_dir.description: The directory untappd_checkin's photo_path must be inside (several allowed, separated by :). Defaults to ~/Downloads/untappd-mcp — put a photo there to attach it. Any other file is refused, so a prompt-injected shout or comment can't publish an arbitrary image from your disk.

untappd_cache_db.title: Cache Database Path
untappd_cache_db.description: Path to the local check-in cache SQLite file (default ~/.untappd-mcp/checkins.db; created owner-only — dir 0700, file 0600). Local/stdio only.
